### Background 
Our goal for this project is to create an analytical workflow which would reproduce **figure 3** from Schaefer et al. (2000). Our created figure will display ion concentrations in streams before and after Hurricane Hugo.

![](/Images/Schaefer_etal_2020_fig3.png)



### Data
The figure we are referencing comes from a Journal of Tropical Ecology, "Effects of Hurricane Disturbance on Stream Water Concentrations and Fluxes in Eight Tropical Forest Watersheds of the Luquillo Experimental Forest, Puerto Rico." The raw data is sourced from the Environmental Data Initiative. The original figure utilized data from sites Q1, Q2, Q3, and PRM. 

```{r}
#| echo: false 
#| output: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
clean_data <- read_csv("../output/clean_data.csv")
```

### Methods 
In order to recreate this figure, a moving average function was created to take the average ion concentration every 9 weeks. This involves using a filtered, combined dataset to which the average function is applied to. 

### Results 
The following figure displays a moving average of ion concentration from 1988 to 1995 across all four sites as indicated by the four different line types. 
```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
# Creating hurricane inidicator as an x-intercept line
hurricane_date <- as.Date("1989-09-18")

# Creating ggplot with longer_sites data
ggplot(
  data = clean_data,
  mapping = aes(
    x = window_start,
    y = Concentration,
    linetype = site
  )
) +
  # Adding geom_line for line plot
  geom_line() +
  # Implementing dashed line to indidicate hurrican occurance
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = hurricane_date,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  # Adding black and white theme
  theme_bw() +
  # facet_wrap allowing for seperation of ions into seperate graph
  facet_wrap(vars(Ion), scales = 'free', ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
  # Changing x-axis label and removing y-axis label
  labs(
    x = "Years",
    y = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  # Deleting lines in the background of the graphs
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.position = "outside"
  )
```
